create_thinker_moe_replacement: create a LinearQwen3OmniThinkerSparseMoeBlock replacement that unfuses fused expert weights for per-expert quantization
create_talker_moe_replacement: create a LinearQwen3OmniTalkerSparseMoeBlock replacement that unfuses fused expert weights with shared expert support
materialize_thinker_expert_weights: materialize fused 3D expert weights into individual nn.Linear layers for the thinker MoE block
materialize_talker_expert_weights: materialize fused 3D expert weights into individual nn.Linear layers for the talker MoE block
run_experts_forward_pass: run the experts_forward method to route tokens through selected MoE experts using top-k routing weights
